test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'Cosmic'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence mentions **that the falcon, as a deity, represents the heavens and its eyes represent the sun and the moon.
 
• The term **"cosmic" **accurately describes the celestial and cosmic associations of the falcon deity.
 
• **It signifies **that the falcon has a connection to the vastness and cosmic elements of the universe.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *The falcon had been worshipped from earliest times as a **cosmic** deity whose body represents the heavens and whose eyes represent the sun and the moon. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation for the** other options:**
 
• **Malevolent:** This term means having or showing a desire to harm others or cause trouble. It is the opposite of the intended meaning and does not align with the positive connotation associated with the falcon deity.
 
• **Modern: **This term refers to the present time or recent times. In the context of ancient Egyptian mythology, the worship of the falcon as a deity existed in ancient times and is not a modern phenomenon.
 
• **Primary:** This term means of chief importance or significance. While it could be used to describe the falcon deity, it does not specifically convey the celestial and cosmic associations mentioned in the sentence.
